cards.back:
A pain in your head.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit kepala
Example: I rested because I had a bad headache.
cards.say: headache. A pain in your head. I rested because I had a bad headache.

cards.back:
A pain in your tummy.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit perut
Example: Too many sweets gave him a stomach ache.
cards.say: stomach ache. A pain in your tummy. Too many sweets gave him a stomach ache.

cards.back:
A pain in one of your teeth.
Bahasa Indonesia: sakit gigi
Example: She saw the dentist because of her toothache.
cards.say: toothache. A pain in one of your teeth. She saw the dentist because of her toothache.

cards.back:
To push air out of your throat with a noise.
Bahasa Indonesia: batuk
Example: Please cover your mouth when you cough.
cards.say: cough. To push air out of your throat with a noise. Please cover your mouth when you cough.

cards.back:
A small illness that makes your nose run.
Bahasa Indonesia: pilek
Example: I have a cold, so I need a tissue.
cards.say: cold. A small illness that makes your nose run. I have a cold, so I need a tissue.

cards.back:
When your body is much hotter than normal.
Bahasa Indonesia: demam
Example: The nurse checked his fever with a thermometer.
cards.say: fever. When your body is much hotter than normal. The nurse checked his fever with a thermometer.

cards.back:
Something you take to help you get better.
Bahasa Indonesia: obat
Example: Mum gave me medicine for my cough.
cards.say: medicine. Something you take to help you get better. Mum gave me medicine for my cough.

cards.back:
A person who looks after your teeth.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter gigi
Example: The dentist checked every tooth in my mouth.
cards.say: dentist. A person who looks after your teeth. The dentist checked every tooth in my mouth.

cards.back:
A person who helps sick people get well.
Bahasa Indonesia: dokter
Example: The doctor listened to my chest carefully.
cards.say: doctor. A person who helps sick people get well. The doctor listened to my chest carefully.

cards.back:
A person who looks after sick people.
Bahasa Indonesia: perawat
Example: The nurse put a plaster on his knee.
cards.say: nurse. A person who looks after sick people. The nurse put a plaster on his knee.

cards.back:
A big building where sick people get care.
Bahasa Indonesia: rumah sakit
Example: My uncle stayed in hospital for two days.
cards.say: hospital. A big building where sick people get care. My uncle stayed in hospital for two days.

cards.back:
A small sticky cover for a cut.
Bahasa Indonesia: plester
Example: She put a plaster on her sore finger.
cards.say: plaster. A small sticky cover for a cut. She put a plaster on her sore finger.

cards.back:
A long strip of cloth to wrap an injury.
Bahasa Indonesia: perban
Example: The nurse wrapped a bandage around his arm.
cards.say: bandage. A long strip of cloth to wrap an injury. The nurse wrapped a bandage around his arm.

cards.back:
Strong and not sick.
Bahasa Indonesia: sehat
Example: Fruit and sleep keep children healthy.
cards.say: healthy. Strong and not sick. Fruit and sleep keep children healthy.

cards.back:
Needing to rest or sleep.
Bahasa Indonesia: lelah
Example: I felt tired after the long walk.
cards.say: tired. Needing to rest or sleep. I felt tired after the long walk.

cards.back:
The part in the middle of your arm that bends.
Bahasa Indonesia: siku
Example: He hurt his elbow when he fell.
cards.say: elbow. The part in the middle of your arm that bends. He hurt his elbow when he fell.

cards.back:
The joint in the middle of your leg.
Bahasa Indonesia: lutut
Example: She scraped her knee on the road.
cards.say: knee. The joint in the middle of your leg. She scraped her knee on the road.

cards.back:
The part of your body between your neck and arm.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahu
Example: My school bag is heavy on my shoulder.
cards.say: shoulder. The part of your body between your neck and arm. My school bag is heavy on my shoulder.

cards.back:
The part that joins your head to your body.
Bahasa Indonesia: leher
Example: A giraffe has a very long neck.
cards.say: neck. The part that joins your head to your body. A giraffe has a very long neck.

cards.back:
The part inside your body where food goes.
Bahasa Indonesia: perut
Example: My stomach makes a noise when I am hungry.
cards.say: stomach. The part inside your body where food goes. My stomach makes a noise when I am hungry.

cards.back:
The back of your mouth and the tube down your neck.
Bahasa Indonesia: tenggorokan
Example: I have a sore throat today.
cards.say: throat. The back of your mouth and the tube down your neck. I have a sore throat today.

cards.back:
To clean something with water and soap.
Bahasa Indonesia: mencuci, membasuh
Example: Wash your hands before you eat lunch.
cards.say: wash. To clean something with water and soap. Wash your hands before you eat lunch.
